## Thesis
### Thesis — Circulation as a conditional encounter

[PUBCLAIM001] Publishing makes an encounter between wanted work and possible readers materially possible, and changes who can judge, keep, share or ask for more of that work. The strongest positive case is not a forecast of sales: it is Mel completing a wanted manuscript, Momiji's actual assistance, Takane's reading, Trinity readers buying and sharing, and Mashiro eventually reading and asking for a continuation. These particular ends deserve attention even if a future book is never finished or an institution never becomes just. They also differ: a manuscript accepted by a recipient is not a print run; reader pleasure is not permission to appropriate the maker's next work; an actual settlement is not an inspected final royalty ratio. Publishing is answerable through these differences rather than through a single success label. [PS02:98–132; PS03:99–159]
### Thesis — Burden and refusal inside useful work

[PUBCLAIM002] The same circulation that opens a new audience can turn hunger, time, property, admiration or publicity into leverage. Yakumo brings useful distribution and later acknowledges book quality, yet presses a consignment decision against immediate payment and uses a false princess biography that Takane rejects. Takane gives real criticism, yet unfinished work can meet a demand to finish before sleep. Mel wants creation and sometimes company, yet presses the adult's declined portrait and objects when she is physically carried to a meeting. These are consequential actions with separate agents and recipients. Later gratitude, renewed willing work or pleased readers support positive afterstates without retroactively authorizing each earlier act or supplying permanent assent. [PS01:279–303; PS02:104–132; PS03:92–135; PS04:80–118]
### Thesis — Roles, local sequence and the ordinary

[PUBCLAIM003] This institution comprises makers, critics, distributor, helpers and readers whose ends can cross without becoming identical. Takane's cooking, sports company and landscape photography, Yakumo's planning pleasure, railway rest and refusal to waste food, Mel's tools and imagined café, and readers' quiet, sharing and private interpretation remain intrinsic evidence. They are not material discarded because they lack a crisis endpoint. The current argument uses four complete maintained analytical carriers received through EOF, preserving their producers' underlying source scopes and modes. E829's local deadline, E852's local trip and permission, private thread codas and conditional written lines cannot be combined into a certified global growth calendar or fictional family biography. This existing institutional home adds no character, relationship or named-duty completion by itself. [PS01:201–319; PS02:136–160; PS03:169–205; PS04:70–267]

## Eight serious rival explanations
### R01 — Publishing is only extraction

[PUBCLAIM034] Deprivation leverage, rejected terms, appropriation and false publicity give this a serious basis. But actual distribution, book-quality acknowledgment, transmitted settlement, readers and Mel's wanted original creation are contrary evidence. The warranted result is useful encounter with unequal and sometimes coercive means, not an innocent core or an exclusively parasitic function. [PS02:128–132; PS03:92–159]
### R02 — A successful book legitimates its production

[PUBCLAIM035] Manuscript acceptance, delighted readers, settlement and Mashiro's new taste make success meaningful. They do not supply permission for earlier carrying, deprivation leverage, false biography or each editorial demand. Current cooperation and renewed assent have specific objects. Final ratio, print-run endpoints and future publicity remain unresolved; success can qualify an outcome without cleansing all means. [PS02:114–132; PS03:92–159]
### R03 — The critic is an impartial guardian of quality

[PUBCLAIM036] Takane's actual reading, precise work criticisms and respect for hidden value support a vocation. Subjective fandom, gatekeeping, an imposed deadline and pressing concealed-book privacy are contrary cases. Her cooking, photography and wanted company also exceed a pure adjudicator role. Preserve local criticisms and their warrants rather than accept a universal credential or discard them because she is fallible. [PS02:92–130; PS04:80–118]
### R04 — Library care makes every restriction or force right

[PUBCLAIM037] Ui and Shimiko provide real object care and access, and local approval enables reading. Their opposed means include threats, an unverified takeover reading, hidden reading under pressure and admitted interpretive commitments; JTF's unread danger inference is also contested. The stopping and approval matter without certifying force, total innocence, universal censorship reform or a future treaty. [PS03:106–163]
### R05 — All participants already chose the burden

[PUBCLAIM038] Later willing work, useful assistance and actual appreciation make assent a serious positive explanation. It cannot absorb earlier objections, a withheld alternative under hunger, Takane's resisted publicity or Momiji's remaining time cost. Yakumo's own labor and waste refusals demonstrate how particular an off-ramp can be. Every new demand needs its own warranted actor, object and stage, not a perpetual contract inferred from belonging. [PS01:281–303; PS02:114–132; PS03:92–140; PS04:148–160]
### R06 — Money is the whole value of circulation

[PUBCLAIM039] The material necessity of printing and actual settlement, Yakumo's money explanation and commercial expansion make this a strong account of one function. Reader imagination, wanted criticism, quiet library encounter, uncompleted creative dreams, shared food and the stated liking of the work are independent counterevidence. Price can help enable encounter without measuring every cultural end; no exact amount, profit series or guaranteed growth is established. [PS01:237–303; PS03:115–169; PS04:70–150]
### R07 — The adult resolves all institutional responsibility

[PUBCLAIM040] Help, reconciliation, refused prestige capture and negotiated permission support practical adult authority. Pulled-arm objections, imposed performance, cold-photo pressure, surprised guarantorship and the explicit responsibility limit are contrary. Other readers, makers, critics and caretakers act on their own judgments. Local completion of a day's work cannot become omniscience, legal absolution, unlimited capacity or a lasting resolution of every school relation. [PS01:285–303; PS03:152–159; PS04:112–156]
### R08 — Ordinary pleasures are only relief after the important conflict

[PUBCLAIM041] Tea, photographs, hockey, beansprout craft, rail rest, books, company, money received and creative wishes are directly wanted activities, with their own disappointments and refusals. They specify what work and membership are for and what they may not consume. They need neither a delivered book nor proof of global reform to count. Their intrinsic value coexists with coercion and does not imply universal comfort, safety or completed future wishes. [PS01:201–303; PS03:169; PS04:70–150]
